create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph and add start and accept nodes with weighted arcs between them
test_graph_equality: test two gtn Graph objects for exact equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes arcs and weights
test_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn Graph objects for structural isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering
save_and_load_graph_binary: save a gtn Graph to a binary file with gtn.save and reload it with gtn.load
save_and_load_graph_text: save a gtn Graph to a text file with gtn.savetxt and reload it with gtn.loadtxt
